events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Plague-Ridden

options.text: Very well. Allow [character] and his troops time to rest.
There is no time. [character] must order his troops to march.

events.text: The [event] strikes through our armies, silent and sudden, leaving our soldiers writhing with fever, chills, and black pocks that cover the body, inside and out. [character], general of a [unit] unit, requests some time for his troops to recover.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Tutorial: Agent Networks

options.text: I will consider converting my Scout into an Agent Network in [city]!

events.text: You've moved [unit] Unit into or adjacent a rival nation's territory. Because you also have a Spymaster on your council, you can convert the Scout into an Agent Network (temporarily consuming the Unit in the process). With the [unit] selected, you can see the Agent Network icon(CREATE_AGENT_NETWORK) button enabled in the Unit Panel on the left. Once you have established an Agent Network in [city], an eligible Character can then be assigned as the local Agent there. To do so, you need to click the Agent icon(AGENT_HIGHLIGHTED) button below the [city] City Banner.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Tutorial: Clear Forests

options.text: I will Cut down forests for Wood until I can build Lumbermill!

events.text: Your [unit] has moved onto a Trees Tile. Worker can spend one Orders to cut down Trees with the icon(REMOVE_TREES) button in the Actions panel on the left, and two Orders can be spent to fully clear the land. These actions both harvest Wood and add it to your stockpile. The Tile in question does not have to be in your territory to icon(REMOVE_TREES) cut down the Trees. Once cut down, Trees take some time to regrow. If you build an Improvement on a Trees Tile, the Wood is automatically harvested as the land is Cleared, all at the cost of three Orders. Eventually, you can research the Forestry Tech to enable the construction of Lumbermill, which are a more regular and sustainable source of Wood. However, they must be built on a Trees Tile, so don't Cut down all of your forests! You can also spend Money to purchase Wood directly from the top bar where it shows your current stockpile totals.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Tutorial: Harvest Resource

options.text: Harvesting is a great way to boost my early economy!

events.text: Your [unit] has moved onto some [resource], a Harvest Resource! Scout, Settler and Worker can spend an Orders to harvest Yields from a Harvest Resource. To do so, click the basket icon(UNIT_ACTION_HARVEST) button in the Action Panel on the left while your [unit] is selected and standing on the Harvest Resource. A Harvest Resource takes a number of Turns to renew before it can be Harvested again. Resources that are within any City's limits, or that are too far from one of your Cities, cannot be harvested.
